info.title: Project HANGAR API
info.description: Phase 0 stub. This is a minimal valid OpenAPI 3.1 document committed as a generated-but-committed artefact (docs/01_ARCHITECTURE.md Principle 10): the Dockerfile's SPA build stage copies it, and `pnpm run api:types` consumes it, so no image can build and no SPA type-checks before either exists. `hangar openapi --out docs/openapi.json` (Phase 15) regenerates it from the Huma router and replaces this stub entirely.
